items.question: Do I need corporate documents or business registration to connect?
items.answer: Not at all! WAPromo connects just as simply as WhatsApp Web. Just scan the QR code with your phone camera in 10 seconds, and your inbox is ready with zero paperwork.

items.question: Does my store phone need to remain turned on and connected?
items.answer: Yes, to keep the WhatsApp session active, ensure your primary store phone stays powered and connected to the internet, just like using standard WhatsApp Web.

items.question: How long does QR code pairing take?
items.answer: Only 5 to 10 seconds. Once scanned, your chats and customer threads instantly synchronize to your multi-agent dashboard.

items.question: How does WAPromo stop two reps from replying to the same customer?
items.answer: WAPromo utilizes atomic realtime locking. The moment Rep Sarah clicks a conversation, it locks on all other reps' screens with a red badge 'Handled by Sarah', and their reply buttons are disabled.

items.question: Do my reps need to know the store WhatsApp password or device PIN?
items.answer: No. Reps log into their own personal accounts. They never access your physical phone, keeping your contacts and master account secure in your hands.

items.question: Can I prevent reps from exporting customer contact lists?
items.answer: Yes! WAPromo includes granular role-based permissions. Owners can enable automatic phone number masking, disable contact export buttons, and restrict broadcast permissions.

items.question: Can the AI assistant hallucinate prices or make false promises?
items.answer: No. WAPromo's assistant is strictly constrained to your verified catalog and knowledge base. If an inquiry falls outside your data, it courteously hands off to your human team.

items.question: When does the AI respond automatically?
items.answer: You have complete control: Always Active Mode, After-Hours Mode (e.g. 9 PM - 8 AM), or Overflow Mode (AI only answers if customers wait longer than 45 seconds during peak traffic).

items.question: Is my phone number safe from WhatsApp spam bans?
items.answer: Very safe when communicating with inbound leads and past customers. WAPromo features human delay simulation (random 8-15 second jitter) and spintax text variation to keep your number healthy.

items.question: What is the recommended warm-up schedule for new numbers?
items.answer: During the first week, handle inbound chats naturally and limit outbound promotions to 20-50 messages per day. Increase volume gradually each week to establish strong sender trust.
